title: 1989 Topps - All Star #398 Julio Franco
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a 1989 Topps baseball trading card featuring Julio Franco of the Cleveland Guardians. This card is part of the All Star subset and has the card number 398. It is a part of the base set for the 1989 season.
